inventory.name: Anodized Torch Barrel
inventory.description: Empty 2xAA flashlight body jammed inside the corridor mail chute.
inventory.inspectNote: Missing its emitter bulb module. Check for an LED capsule.

inventory.name: 365nm UV Emitter Bulb

inventory.inspectNote: Emits 365nm UV beam. Reveals hidden audit ink, oil notes, and storm-wall markings.

inventory.description: Heavy triangular steel elevator key. Pass through the Mail Chute to your partner.
inventory.inspectNote: Stamped "LIFT LOBBY 4F · OVERRIDE". Required on the Corridor Lift Gate.

clues.title: Monsoon Blackout · 21:40 IST
clues.detail: Security Booth CAM 01 shows the 4th-floor hallway outside Flat 4B with a timestamp +05:00 ahead (21:45). Work across all 12 wings of Marina Towers to uncover why.

clues.detail: Insulated Bakelite grip locked onto a 6mm brass flathead shaft. Fits 4B junction cover screws.

clues.title: Chapter 01 Cleared · Blackout on Floor 4
clues.detail: With the 240V relay balanced, the crawlspace hatch clicks open into the locked 4th-floor corridor.

clues.title: Crafted: UV Blacklight Torch
clues.detail: Emits 365nm UV beam. Reveals hidden audit ink, oil notes, and storm-wall markings.

clues.title: UV Ink · Noticeboard (4F)
clues.detail: Invisible ink reads: "KEYBOX RING 1 = 7 · RING 2 = 3 · Supervisor Shift 21:41–21:45"

clues.title: UV Ink · Corridor Doorframe
clues.detail: Scrawled by the deadbolt: "KEYBOX RING 3 = 9 · Remap 4B Calendar stays 9527"

clues.title: Chapter 02 Cleared · The Locked Corridor
clues.detail: The elevator lobby gate slides free—leading both of you toward the stalled freight lift shaft.

clues.title: Shaft Voltmeter Signal Synced
clues.detail: 5F Machine Room Terminal Order confirmed: GOLD → RED → GREEN → BLUE.

clues.title: Chapter 03 Cleared · Service Lift Shaft
clues.detail: Steel cables groan as the lift brakes release cleanly, dropping you into the humming Mezzanine Meter Vault.

clues.title: UV Coolant Targets (Mezzanine)
clues.detail: Valve I = 45 PSI · Valve II = 70 PSI · Valve III = 30 PSI. Firing Order: L2 → L1 → L3.

chat.text: Emergency backup lights engaged. Both rooms locked on Floor 4. Explore your props, combine tools in your Field Bag, and coordinate on radio.
